title: Transformational Change & Strategic Leadership
overview: This course is designed to equip leaders and senior management with the skills and knowledge to navigate the rapidly changing business environment driven by swift and often turbulent market shifts. Participants will have the opportunity to explore innovative alternatives to their current business models and gain proficiency in using strategic tools and planning techniques to guide their organizations through their next transformational journey.
audience: This course is ideal for leaders, department heads, managers, supervisors, project managers, change agents, sponsors, and anyone involved in driving transformational change within their organization.
methodology: Participants are encouraged to come prepared with current transformational business challenges. Throughout the course, they will be guided through the content, coached on utilizing relevant tools, and exposed to strategic models, business cases, and concepts that can be applied in their organizations.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Develop a deep understanding of the importance of transformational change
Assemble a team of key managers and influencers to drive the desired change
Foster organizational acceptance and support for the transformation process
Maintain open and effective communication throughout the transformational journey
Create and implement a strategic plan to successfully lead transformational change
